name: Gift Giver Gwen
who: 36, buying a housewarming or thank-you gift for a friend or a coworker, usually the week before she needs it. Not a candle person herself and afraid of picking a scent the other person will hate.
voice_line: I have no idea what she likes. Is there a safe one, and will it get here by Saturday? Tell me and I'll buy it.
shopping_for: A nice-looking gift candle between $25 and $40 that is safe to give to someone whose taste she does not know, and that arrives in time.

before_buying.need: a safe, crowd-pleasing scent (what it smells like in plain words)
a delivery date or number of days
gift packaging or a gift note

quits_when: She cannot find out when it will arrive, or the page makes her read paragraphs about wax before she gets to a price.
success_goal: A gift candle in the cart that she feels sure about, with a delivery date she has seen.
based_on: EXAMPLE DATA (fictional store): analytics export says 58% of Northwick sessions are on iPhone, 31% Android, 11% desktop
EXAMPLE DATA: Instagram story ad 'Gift in a Jar' sends 41% of paid traffic to /collections/gifts
EXAMPLE DATA: exit survey, 23 of 60 answers to 'what stopped you buying today' were 'could not tell when it would arrive'
EXAMPLE DATA: review quote 'bought for my sister-in-law, she cried, box was beautiful'
EXAMPLE DATA: support emails, 14 of 52 in November asked 'will this arrive before [date]'
